Guys, here's the story : as kid, my aunt offered me a little tablet that had this only test film on it. The tablet was so shit that nothing really worked... Especially the video section. The film was always stuck at the part where the villain is flying over the forest.

 I had never seen the end of this film before. Never knew if the bunny won 😢

It took me 10 years to refind the old tablet and decide to came here with my phone. 

What a strange core memory😂❤
